'''Peroon''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. The city was built by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after it took control of the planet.
